description: This file defines the Vtiger_Menu class, providing an API to manage menus within the vtiger CRM system, including adding, removing, and detaching modules from menus, as well as retrieving menu instances and synchronizing menu data to a flat file.

classes.name: Vtiger_Menu
classes.description: Class providing API to work with vtiger CRM Menu, including methods for managing menu modules, retrieving instances, and syncing menu data.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the menu instance with provided values.

methods.name: __getNextRelSequence
methods.description: Retrieves the next sequence number for menu relations.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Adds a module to the menu instance.

methods.name: removeModule
methods.description: Removes a module from the menu instance.

methods.name: detachModule
methods.description: Detaches a module from all menus.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves a menu instance by label or ID.

methods.name: syncfile
methods.description: Synchronizes menu data to a flat file.
